per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall ensure that UI interactions such as searching or opening movie details complete within 5 seconds.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'Any interface between a user and the automated system shall have a maximum response time of 5 seconds unless noted by an exception below.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall complete card authorization within 15 seconds from submission to result.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'When purchasing a streaming movie or pre-paid card via credit card the processing time should have a maximum response time of 15 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall start streaming playback with no more than 10 seconds of buffering.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: When streaming a movie the buffering time should take no longer than 10 seconds (plus any latency on the user's connection.)'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall be designed with simplicity in mind, requiring few clicks and intuitive flows for novice users.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall be easy for customers with novice skills on the Internet to purchase and watch streaming movies. Customers should be able to purchase and watch a pre-determined movie in under 3 minutes.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall support local languages and currencies to build trust with users.
The system shall achieve 99.5% uptime to ensure high availability and avoid revenue loss.
The system shall encrypt payment data and restrict access to sensitive information based on roles.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'All credit card information will be secured on the server and only accessible by authorized Izogn administrators. Information will be encrypted in the database.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall implement role-based access control and two-factor authentication for admin access.
The system shall include admin tools to avoid manual work, such as managing pre-paid codes without spreadsheets.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'Daily usage statistics should be logged and accessible by the administrator.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall support a few concurrent users on admin dashboards during peak times.
The system shall include a clear and prominently linked privacy policy on every page.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The website shall make its user aware of its information practices before collection data from them via a Privacy Policy accessible on all pages of the website.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall include daily business metrics and health alerts for operational monitoring.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'Daily usage statistics should be logged and accessible by the administrator.'
